description: A lookup, not a model: the gene's single-mutant fitness in the Costanzo 2016 screens at 30 C, minimum over its KanMX and NatMX deletion strains, scored as 1 - fitness. A gene with no deletion strain measured scores 1: the deletion collection lacks the genes whose deletion did not live.
data_description: SmfCostanzo2016Dataset via tc-data archive smf_costanzo2016-1.5.0-d8a0f06c.tar.xz (sha256 d8a0f06cb534), preprocess/data.csv: another TorchCell dataset read as the score, so transductive on the database
